implementation: One guard (src/lib/api/sameHostGuard.ts) owns the Host/Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site rule. server.js applies it in front of Next to every /api request and every upgrade and fails startup if the guard or tsx cannot load; the token, unlock and local-seats routes call it before parsing a body or running a KDF; both WebSocket channels accept at most 1 MiB per frame; the packaged-socket validator gains same-host rows. The guard errs toward guarding: encoded, dot-segment, backslash and upper-case spellings of /api and undecodable targets count as API routes; it has four readings (fully decoded, decoded URL-parsed pathname, raw prefix, URL-parsed prefix).
